data_description.mode: Cloud: full functionality including control, requires a Cloud API key. Local: sensors only, read directly from the Energy Edge EX.1 gateway, no internet required.

cloud.title: Set up ABB Smart EMS Cloud
cloud.description:
The ABB cloud is accessed with a **Cloud API key** only — there is no sign-in with email and password.

How to create a key: [Smart EMS API]({kb_url})

data_description.abb_id: The ID of your Energy Edge EX.1. In the myBuildings portal, open the gateway's device overview (Hardware → Manage); it is shown there as ID.
data_description.api_key: In the Smart EMS web portal, open your profile (top right) and create a new key under Cloud API keys. Preferably do NOT enable key renewal. If the menu entry is missing, contact support — the feature is enabled on request.

local.title: Set up local connection
local.description: The local API must be enabled on the gateway first (myBuildings portal → device overview of the Energy Edge EX.1 → enable the interface).

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Energy Edge EX.1 gateway (e.g. 192.168.1.100). The IP address is shown in the device overview of the myBuildings portal.
data_description.scheme: HTTP for unencrypted, HTTPS for encrypted (self-signed certificates are accepted).
data_description.api_key: Optional key of the local interface, generated in the device overview of the myBuildings portal. This is not the Cloud API key. Leave empty if no key is configured.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate ABB Smart EMS
reauth_confirm.description:
The Cloud API key for gateway **{abb_id}** was rejected (invalid, expired or deleted). Enter a valid key.

How to create a key: [Smart EMS API]({kb_url})

reauth_local.title: Update local API key
reauth_local.description: The local API of gateway **{host}** rejected the request. Enter the current API key. Leave empty if the gateway no longer requires a key.

data_description.mode: Keep the current mode to update credentials, or pick the other mode to switch. Sensors and devices keep their existing entity IDs.

reconfigure_cloud.title: Reconfigure ABB Smart EMS Cloud
reconfigure_cloud.description: Leave the key field empty to keep the stored Cloud API key.

reconfigure_local.title: Reconfigure local connection
reconfigure_local.description: Leave the API key empty to keep the stored key.

switch_to_cloud.title: Switch to Cloud mode
switch_to_cloud.description:
Enter the gateway ID and a **Cloud API key**.

How to create a key: [Smart EMS API]({kb_url})

data_description.abb_id: The ID of your Energy Edge EX.1. In the myBuildings portal, open the gateway's device overview (Hardware → Manage); it is shown there as ID.
data_description.api_key: In the Smart EMS web portal, open your profile (top right) and create a new key under Cloud API keys. Preferably do NOT enable key renewal.

switch_to_local.title: Switch to local mode
switch_to_local.description: Warning: operating modes, parameters and charging-target datetimes (select/number/datetime) only exist in Cloud mode. After switching they become unavailable — scripts, automations and dashboards using these controls will stop working. Switching back to Cloud reuses the same entity IDs.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Energy Edge EX.1 gateway (e.g. 192.168.1.100).
data_description.scheme: HTTP for unencrypted, HTTPS for encrypted (self-signed certificates are accepted).
data_description.api_key: Optional key of the local interface. This is not the Cloud API key. Leave empty if no key is configured.

error.auth: The API key was rejected. Check the key and the gateway ID and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Connection failed. Is the API or the gateway reachable?
error.rate_limit: API rate limit reached (the token exchange allows 50 requests per hour). Please try again later.
error.credentials_required: Enter both the gateway ID and a Cloud API key.
error.unknown: Unknown error. Please check the logs.

abort.already_configured: This ABB Smart EMS system is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: Re-authentication successful. The integration will be reloaded.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Reconfiguration successful. The integration will be reloaded.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the API is polled. Recommended: 10 seconds. The cloud allows 500 requests per hour and endpoint.

battery_settings_not_loaded.message: Battery settings are not loaded yet — write aborted to avoid resetting other fields to their defaults. Please try again in a few seconds.

surplus_available.name: PV surplus available
surplus_available.description: Triggers once PV surplus (PV power minus consumption minus battery power) stays above a threshold for a set duration.

is_surplus_present.name: PV surplus present
is_surplus_present.description: Tests whether PV surplus has been continuously above a threshold for a set duration.
